'''Anne Borg''' (born September 27, 1958) is a Norwegian professor of [[physics]] and was [[Rector (academia)|rector]] (2019–2023) at the [[Norwegian University of Science and Technology]] in [[Trondheim]]. She was [[prorector]] of education at NTNU from August 1, 2017, to August 20, 2019. She was appointed acting rector of NTNU on August 21, 2019, later being officially employed as rector on December 13 the same year.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.nrk.no/trondelag/gunnar-bovim-gar-av-som-ntnu-rektor-1.14663246|title=Gunnar Bovim går av som NTNU-rektor|last=Kringstad|first=Kirsti|date=2019-08-16|website=NRK|language=nb-NO|access-date=2019-08-22}}</ref>

Her areas of research are [[Surface science|surface]] and [[materials physics]], [[scanning probe microscopy]], [[Photoemission spectroscopy|photoelectron spectroscopy]] and [[density functional theory]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.ntnu.edu/employees/anne.borg|title=Anne Borg|website=www.ntnu.edu|language=en|access-date=2019-08-22}}</ref>

== Education and professional career ==
Borg was born in [[Drammen]]. She has an [[Master of Science|Msc]] ([[sivilingeniør]]) in applied physics from the [[Norwegian Institute of Technology]] (NTH),<ref>as of 1996 NTH is part of the Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU)</ref> [[Trondheim]], (1982), and in 1987 she received her [[Doctor of Philosophy|PhD]] in physics at NTNU, with the [[thesis]] ''Infrared spectroscopy for studies of molecular vibrations at surfaces : construction and testing of a wavelength modulation infrared spectrometer''.<ref>{{Cite journal|date=1989|title=Infrared spectroscopy for studies of molecular vibrations at surfaces: Construction and testing of a wavelength modulation infrared spectrometer.|url=https://elibrary.ru/item.asp?id=6842474|journal=Russian Website. Shows a Summary of the Thesis|page=1|last1=Borg|first1=A.}}</ref>

After having finished her PhD, she worked as a post doctor at [[Stanford University]], [[Stanford Synchrotron Radiation Laboratory]] in 1988–1989, and held various research positions at NTH, NTNU and [[SINTEF]].

In 1998 she was appointed professor at the Department of Physics, NTNU.

She has been a strong voice in Norway for the development of [[Synchrotron radiation|synchrotron light]] research, especially towards, and in cooperation with, the MAX-lab in Lund. She was also a member of the MaS-lab board between 2006 and 2010, and of the MAX IV Laboratory Program Advisory Committee (PAC in the period 2011–2014 She is currently (2018) chairing the Scientific Advisory Committee (SAC) at MAX IV Laboratory.<ref name=":0" /> <ref>{{Cite web |last=Abdullayeva |first=Leyla |date=2018-08-02 |title=2 honorary doctorates for 2 pillars of MAX IV’s timeline |url=https://www.maxiv.lu.se/article/2-honorary-doctorates-for-2-pillars-of-max-ivs-past-present-and-future/ |access-date=2026-03-27 |website=MAX IV |language=en-US}}</ref>

== Memberships and honours ==
She is elected member of The [[Royal Norwegian Society of Sciences and Letters]],<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.dknvs.no/akademiet/medlemmer/gruppe-ii-fysikk/|title=Gruppe II Fysikk {{!}} DKNVS|language=nb-NO|access-date=2019-08-22}}</ref> and of the [[Norwegian Academy of Technological Sciences]] (NTVA).<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.ntva.no/medlemmer/medlemsoversikt/|title=Medlemsoversikt|last=wpnimda|publisher=[[Norwegian Academy of Technological Sciences]]|language=nb-NO|access-date=2019-08-22|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190209124532/https://www.ntva.no/medlemmer/medlemsoversikt/|archive-date=2019-02-09|url-status=dead}}</ref>

She was vice president of the [[Norwegian Physical Society]] in 2002–2003, and president of the society in 2004–2007.<ref>{{Cite book|url=http://www.norskfysisk.no/filer/aarsmeldinger/arsmelding2006_2007.pdf|title=Norsk Fysisk Selskap. Årsmelding 2006–2007|publisher=[[Norwegian Physical Society]]|year=2007}}</ref>

In 2018 she was awarded an [[Honorary degree|honorary doctorate]] at [[Lund University]] in Sweden.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|url=https://www.maxiv.lu.se/news/prof-anne-borg-honorary-doctor-at-lund-university/|title=Prof. Anne Borg Honorary Doctor at Lund University – MAX IV|website=www.maxiv.lu.se|access-date=2019-08-22}}</ref>
